claims.claim: Pooled AUROC of failure predictors is dominated by issue difficulty, so routing evidence needs within-issue controls.
claims.stance_target: R1 candidate L3; component verdict: NARROW-context
claims.quoted_support: A score that only knows whether an issue is hard reaches 0.90 pooled AUROC, yet it cannot rank two runs of the same issue (0.50).

claims.claim: On SWE-bench Verified trajectories a run-blind difficulty reference reaches 0.92 AUROC while trajectory predictors reach about 0.62.
claims.stance_target: R1 candidate L3; component verdict: NARROW-context
claims.quoted_support: a reference score that never looks at the run, only at how hard the issue is for other models, reaches 0.92 AUROC, whereas trajectory predictors reach about 0.62.

claims.claim: Per-issue model switching gains nothing on held-out runs and the oracle gap is no larger than random variation.
claims.stance_target: R1 candidate L3; component verdict: NARROW-context
claims.quoted_support: This gap is no larger than random variation alone produces. Per-issue switching gains nothing on held-out runs.
